input_usuario: Média salarial dos servidores ativos em 2024.
query_referencia: WITH sal AS (SELECT seq_dim_pessoa, MAX(CAST(vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS salario FROM remuneracao_municipio WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND dsc_sit_serv_pens ILIKE '%Ativo%' GROUP BY seq_dim_pessoa) SELECT AVG(salario) AS media FROM sal;
query_gerada: SELECT AVG(CAST(r.vlr_rmn_liquida AS DECIMAL)) AS media_salarial FROM remuneracao_municipio r JOIN pessoa_municipio p ON r.seq_dim_pessoa = p.seq_dim_pessoa WHERE r.ano_referencia = 2024 AND COALESCE(p.nom_pessoa, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' AND r.dsc_sit_serv_pens ILIKE '%Ativo%'
